pages.text: Life above the single creature: whole populations, their evolution, life built to a plan, and life built backwards. And the keystone that ties the branch together.

$(thing)Ecology$(): the $(item)Ecosphere$() holds a world in balance. Stock predator and prey near their Lotka-Volterra balance point and the cycle holds; stock too far off and it swings until one side crashes. It makes $(item)Stable Ecosystems$() and the $(item)Symbiont Lining$() (catalysts wear 40% slower).

$(thing)Population Genetics$(): the $(item)Selection Chamber$() breeds a trait in. A useful one fixes with chance (1 - e^(-2s)) / (1 - e^(-4Ns)): too weak and drift loses it, too strong and the culture dies. It feeds the Evolution Engine cheaply. $(thing)Gene Circuits$(): the $(item)Gene Circuit Loom$() wires genes into switches (bistable only when the cooperativity is over one) and makes the $(item)Living Catalyst$(), which heals its own wear while fed.

$(thing)Mirror Life$(): the $(item)Mirror Culture Vat$() grows cells built the wrong way round, on mirror food (natural food poisons them). Their $(item)Mirror Antibodies$() are the only answer to the Antiverse's Mirror Microbes.

$(thing)The Tree of Life$(): the five pieces of life, one from each phase, a $(item)Living Cell$(), a Pure Culture, a $(item)Grown Organ$(), an $(item)Antibody$() and a $(item)Stable Ecosystem$(), together make the $(item)Tree of Life$(): an endgame catalyst that never wears, the keystone of the branch.
